title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Size of a Dispute Credit and the Recorded Decision
content:
## Definition

Where a customer contests the demurrage billed on a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record, citing misapplied rates or free time:

- The **excess billed** is the amount at which the line was invoiced, less its recomputed amount. If recomputation yields the invoiced amount or more, the excess is nil.
- The **credit** equals whichever is smaller, the excess billed or the amount the dispute puts in issue, taken to the cent.

## How the decision is recorded

| Credit compared with the disputed amount | Decision recorded | Credit entry |
|---|---|---|
| equal to it | upheld | booked |
| above nothing but below it | partially upheld | booked |
| no excess billed at all | denied | none is booked |

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical)

| Invoiced | Recomputed | Excess billed | Disputed amount | Credit | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1400.00 | 1250.00 | 150.00 | 1100.00 | 150.00 | partially upheld |
| 1400.00 | 1250.00 | 150.00 | 120.00 | 120.00 | upheld |
| 1400.00 | 1450.00 | none | 300.00 | none | denied |

The excess is measured from the invoiced amount of the line, so waivers or credits already booked against the line do not change it.
